# google_dialogflow_tool

A tool defines an action and its corresponding schema.


To get more information about Tool, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/dialogflow/es/docs/reference/rest/v2beta1/projects.locations.tools)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/docs/)

## Example Usage - Dialogflow Tool Basic


```hcl
resource "google_dialogflow_tool" "basic_tool" {
  location = "global"
  display_name = "dialogflow-tool"
  description = "A basic open_api_spec tool"
  tool_key = "dialogflow-tool"
  open_api_spec {
    text_schema = "openapi: 3.0.0\ninfo:\n  title: Example API\n  version: 1.0.0\npaths:\n  /example:\n    get:\n      summary: Example GET\n      responses:\n        '200':\n          description: OK"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  Optional. The human-readable name of the tool, unique within an agent.

* `description` -
  (Required)
  Optional. High level description of the tool and its usage.

* `tool_key` -
  (Required)
  Required. The tooltip key of the tool.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the tool.


* `action_confirmation_requirement` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Action confirmation requirement for each action.

* `extension_spec` -
  (Optional, Deprecated)
  Deprecated. Extension tool specification.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_extension_spec).

  ~> **Warning:** Extension tool specification is deprecated.

* `function_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Function tool specification.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_function_spec).

* `connector_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Connector tool specification.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_connector_spec).

* `open_api_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. OpenAPI tool specification.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_open_api_spec).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_extension_spec"></a>The `extension_spec` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Optional)
  Required. The name of the extension.

<a name="nested_function_spec"></a>The `function_spec` block supports:

* `input_schema` -
  (Optional)
  Required. The input schema.

<a name="nested_connector_spec"></a>The `connector_spec` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Optional)
  Required. The connector name.

<a name="nested_open_api_spec"></a>The `open_api_spec` block supports:

* `text_schema` -
  (Optional)
  Required. The OpenAPI schema in text format.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The unique identifier of the tool.
  Format: `projects/<Project ID>/locations/<Location ID>/tools/<Tool ID>`.

* `satisfies_pzs` -
  Output only. A boolean value indicating whether the tool satisfies the requirements of PZS.

* `satisfies_pzi` -
  Output only. A boolean value indicating whether the tool satisfies the requirements of PZI.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 40 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 40 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Tool can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/tools/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}`
* `{{location}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Tool using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/tools/{{name}}"
  to = google_dialogflow_tool.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Tool can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_tool.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/tools/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_tool.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_tool.default {{location}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_tool.default {{name}}
```
